title: Converged view invariant and single schema owner
objective: Define the exactness boundary and make every settled session-owned rendering input flow through one DurableSessionView schema.
requirements: Separate DurableSessionView, RenderContext, transient runtime controls, and operational identity.
SessionSnapshot and checkpoint must each embed exactly one DurableSessionView.
Future session-owned visible fields must create a compile-time schema change instead of a resume-only compatibility path.
result: DurableSessionView is the single persisted/publication schema; transient overlays and RenderContext are explicitly classified.
